Class OrderingTrends

java.lang.Object
com.pos.OrderingTrends
public class OrderingTrends extends Object
Manager report showing ordering trends over a selected date range. Includes total sales, order count, busiest hour, daily sales, the top selling drinks, and revenue by category.
Author:
Dylan, Humaid Syed

    • loadReport

      private static void loadReport(LocalDate from, LocalDate to, javafx.scene.control.Label totalSalesValue, javafx.scene.control.Label ordersValue, javafx.scene.control.Label busiestHourValue, javafx.scene.chart.LineChart<String,Number> salesChart, javafx.scene.control.ListView<String> topDrinksList, javafx.scene.chart.BarChart<String,Number> categoryChart, ItemSalesPane itemSales)
      Loads every section of the report for the given date range.
      Parameters:
      from - the first day of the range (inclusive)
      to - the last day of the range (inclusive)
      totalSalesValue - label showing total sales
      ordersValue - label showing the number of orders
      busiestHourValue - label showing the busiest hour
      salesChart - chart of sales per day
      topDrinksList - list of the top selling drinks
      categoryChart - chart of revenue per category
      itemSales - complete per-item sales breakdown
